technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating CRM and finance data and building planning and forecasting models is standard but broad enterprise engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and planning data give some lock in, but well funded forecasting vendors overlapped.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Lennar completed a merger acquiring it on January 14, 2026, an enterprise buyer outside software.

market_need_then: Revenue forecasting was a funded category in 2022, with Clari raising 225M and BoostUp 28.5M that year.

branding.domain_note: Used tigereye.com exact match (YC listing); acquisition history unknown.
branding.brand_signature: Founders' PlanGrid pedigree rather than a visual asset

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; press centered on the founders' PlanGrid history; the name matches the gemstone and unrelated trademarks.

outcome_analysis: TigerEye was started by the PlanGrid founders, raised a 5 million seed and a 30 million Series A in 2022 and joined YC in Summer 2022. It was acquired by homebuilder Lennar in January 2026 for undisclosed terms. Strong founder credibility drove funding, while the crowded forecasting category and the non software buyer suggest an exit below the capital raised is possible but unconfirmed.
notes: Axios corrected its story: total 35M, Series A 30M co-led by Initialized and Next47. Seed 5M and its investors come from Finsmes and Seedtable; seed date is only 2022.
